question: What does the angry one destroy in the triple world?
premises: kruddhaḥ tu saṃharet sarvaṃ is stated
trailokyaṃ sa cara acaram is stated
inference: When angry, he destroys all of the triple world, moving and unmoving.
uncertainties: whether sa cara acaram is a compound phrase
plain_english: When angry, he destroys all of the triple world, moving and unmoving.
